name: Patterned Ground
desc: Periglacial ground sorting itself — freeze-thaw cycling drives stones apart from silt into polygonal nets on the flat crown that stretch out into downslope stripes on the flanks, the whole pattern creeping steadily downhill under a low raking arctic sun.

energy.doc: sorting rate and frost-heave shading contrast

density.doc: clast fraction — how much of the ground is stone

speed.doc: rate multiplier on growth and process time

tilt.doc: hillslope gradient: flat holds nets, steep draws them into stripes
